environment.description: AWS Lambda function behind API Gateway (REST API, no request validation model). Lambda connects directly to MongoDB Atlas M10 cluster (mongodb+srv://). API Gateway has no request body transformation or validation templates. Lambda execution role has full network access via VPC NAT gateway. No AWS WAF attached to the API Gateway stage. MongoDB user has readWrite role on appdb.

config.api_gateway: REST API, no request validators, proxy integration
config.network: Lambda in VPC with NAT, MongoDB Atlas IP whitelist includes NAT EIP
